interest: Index on Japan dangling warship visits to keep Chile neutral.
overview: Cross-reference (1942): agent Sozan Miyoshi offered Chile Japanese warship visits in exchange for fuel oil, aimed at Chilean neutrality.

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet noting intelligence that Japanese agent Sozan Miyoshi offered to arrange a visit of Japanese warships to Chile if provided with fuel oil to help keep Chile neutral.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference: agent Sozan Miyoshi offered Chile a visit by four or five Japanese warships, in exchange for fuel oil.
subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet concerning reported visit of Japanese warships to Chile
